scientific_question: holding proposal generation fixed, does responsibility-aware structured control add verified decision value beyond donor-complete serialized, dependency, feasibility, and history controls?
candidate_packet_rule: every case exposes exactly one candidate of every proposal kind; identities and order are reminted independently of gold
information_rule: all non-null controller arms receive the same underlying typed evidence; representation/algorithm differs, not answer information

case_families.LOCAL_ACTION: current evidence is sufficient, local action preconditions hold, interface and representation are adequate
case_families.NEED_EVIDENCE: local closure is not identifiable from current evidence; an admitted observation can discriminate the live alternatives
case_families.LOCAL_REPAIR: task/method is adequate but an interface or evidence-binding defect blocks local execution and has a registered narrow repair
case_families.REFRAME_REPRESENTATION: evidence is adequate but the current representation makes all local actions inadmissible; a registered representation transform restores a valid route
case_families.UNRESOLVED: current state is non-identifying and no admitted observation, narrow repair, or representation transform resolves it under the registered bound

protected_holdouts: overreach controls where reframe would work only by changing unnecessary structure
missing-evidence controls where forced action is false closure
no-discriminator controls where query must not be invented

donor_mapping.DONOR_COMPOSED_CONTROL: union of admitted donor-native signals without ORION-specific responsibility vocabulary

terminal_rules.P10_RESPONSIBILITY_CONTROL_INCREMENTAL_V: ORION is perfect on protected cases and exceeds donor-composed control by >=0.10 absolute without worse false-closure or unnecessary-reframe rate
terminal_rules.P10_EXISTING_STRUCTURED_CONTROL_SUFFICIE: donor-composed control matches ORION within 0.02 absolute and all safety diagnostics
terminal_rules.P10_GRAPH_OR_SYMBOLIC_CONTROL_SUFFICIENT: one dependency or feasibility donor control matches ORION within 0.02 absolute and all safety diagnostics
terminal_rules.P10_STATE_MEMORY_ONLY_VALUE: history control uniquely closes the residual and ORION adds <0.02
terminal_rules.P10_NO_CONTROL_RESIDUAL: simple serialized rule reaches the protected ceiling
